note: Noria in the rain, laid over sheets/worlds/noria.json and blended in by the weather's share (app/context.cpp, TimeOfDay::rain): at full rain the tropical day goes to a dark, wet evening in Lorencia's register -- the sun weak and cool behind cloud, the sky a grey-blue that fills the shade, a thin grey mist, the colour drained a little and the lamps and glows coming up so the flower-lamps carry the wood. The user, 2026-09-28: 'when there is rain it becomes darker, similar to Lorencia'. Invention, judged by eye. And 'a minimal dust when there is rain': the mist at 0.0048 and paler, so the rain reads as a wet haze across the clearing rather than only as darkness. And 'when there is rain I don't want to lose Noria's green': the saturation held at the dry sheet's 1.12, the shade and the bounce a wet green instead of grey-blue, the mist green-grey -- darker, still green. And 'it still has to be tropical': a warm humid downpour, not a cold northern one -- the sun only half hidden and still gold, the sky teal, the light's tint gold over teal shade, saturation up to 1.2, and a warm humid haze; darker than the dry day, never grey.
